glosses: assault (violent onset or attack with physical means)
mugging, robbery (quick violent robbery of a person)
round (one of the specified pre-determined segments of the total time of a match)

examples.text: Fue noqueado de un puñetazo en el primer asalto.
examples.en: He was knocked out by a punch in the first round.

examples.text: Tom y su cómplice estaban armados con fusiles de asalto.
examples.en: Tom and his accomplice were armed with assault rifles.

examples.text: Aún está por establecerse si Tom estuvo involucrado en el asalto al banco.
examples.en: Tom's involvement in the bank robbery is yet to be established.

examples.text: Tom le preguntó a Mary si acaso sabía en dónde podría comprar un rifle de asalto.
examples.en: Tom asked Mary if she knew where he could buy an assault rifle.
